parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS id_colaborador, c.nome_abreviado AS colaborador, ds.descricao AS senioridade, dc.descricao AS cargo, s.nome_skill AS skill, cs.nivel_conhecimento, a.id AS id_alocacao, d.id AS id_demanda, d.nome_demanda AS demanda, p.ano, p.mes, COALESCE(p.porcentagem, 0) AS percentual_na_demanda FROM "InHire".colaboradores c JOIN "InHire".dominios ds ON ds.id = c.id_senioridade AND ds.tipo_dominio = 'SENIORIDADE' AND ds.status IS TRUE AND ds.deletado IS FALSE LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios dc ON dc.id = c.id_cargo AND dc.tipo_dominio = 'CARGO' AND dc.status IS TRUE AND dc.deletado IS FALSE JOIN "InHire".colaborador_skills cs ON cs.id_colaborador = c.id AND cs.status IS TRUE AND cs.deletado IS FALSE JOIN "InHire".skills s ON s.id = cs.id_skill AND s.status IS TRUE AND s.deletado IS FALSE LEFT JOIN "InHire".alocacoes a ON a.id_colaborador = c.id AND a.status IS TRUE AND a.deletado IS FALSE LEFT JOIN "InHire".demandas d ON d.id = a.id_demanda AND d.status IS TRUE AND d.deletado IS FALSE LEFT JOIN "InHire".planejamentos p ON p.id_alocacao = a.id AND p.status IS TRUE AND p.deletado IS FALSE WHERE c.status IS TRUE AND c.deletado IS FALSE;

SELECT t.id AS id_talento, t.nome_abreviado AS talento, ds.descricao AS senioridade, dc.descricao AS cargo, s.nome_skill AS skill, dn.descricao AS nivel_conhecimento, COALESCE(t.disponibilidade_informada_percentual, 100) AS disponibilidade FROM "InHire".talentos t LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios ds ON ds.id = t.id_senioridade AND ds.tipo_dominio = 'SENIORIDADE' LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios dc ON dc.id = t.id_cargo AND dc.tipo_dominio = 'CARGO' JOIN "InHire".talento_skills ts ON ts.id_talento = t.id JOIN "InHire".skills s ON s.id = ts.id_skill LEFT JOIN "InHire".dominios dn ON dn.id = ts.id_nivel_conhecimento AND dn.tipo_dominio = 'NIVEL_CONHECIMENTO' WHERE t.status IS TRUE AND s.status IS TRUE AND s.deletado IS FALSE;

WITH parametros AS (
    SELECT 
        {{ Number($json.body?.id_colaborador) }} AS p_id_colab,
        {{ $json.body?.id_demanda ? Number($json.body.id_demanda) : 'NULL::bigint' }} AS p_id_demanda,
        '{{ ($json.body?.nova_demanda_nome || "Demanda Temporária").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS p_nome_demanda,
        '{{ $json.body?.nova_demanda_inicio || "2026-01-01" }}'::date AS p_dt_inicio,
        '{{ $json.body?.nova_demanda_fim || "2026-12-31" }}'::date AS p_dt_fim,
        {{ Number($json.body?.percentual ?? 100) }} AS p_percentual,
        '{{ ($json.body?.mes || "Nov").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS p_mes,
        {{ Number($json.body?.ano ?? 2026) }} AS p_ano
),
demanda_resolvida AS (
    INSERT INTO "InHire".demandas (
        nome_demanda, dt_inicio_demanda, dt_termino_demanda_prevista, 
        id_gerente, id_contrato, id_tipo_servico, id_andamento_demanda, status, deletado
    )
    SELECT p_nome_demanda, p_dt_inicio, p_dt_fim, 1, 1, 1, 1, true, false
    FROM parametros WHERE p_id_demanda IS NULL
    RETURNING id
),
id_final_demanda AS (
    SELECT p_id_demanda AS id FROM parametros WHERE p_id_demanda IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id FROM demanda_resolvida
),
alocacao_existente AS (
    SELECT id FROM "InHire".alocacoes
    WHERE id_colaborador = (SELECT p_id_colab FROM parametros)
      AND id_demanda = (SELECT id FROM id_final_demanda)
    LIMIT 1
),
nova_alocacao AS (
    INSERT INTO "InHire".alocacoes (id_colaborador, id_demanda, status, deletado)
    SELECT (SELECT p_id_colab FROM parametros), (SELECT id FROM id_final_demanda), true, false
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alocacao_existente)
    RETURNING id
),
alocacao_resolvida AS (
    SELECT id FROM alocacao_existente
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id FROM nova_alocacao
),
atualiza_planejamento AS (
    UPDATE "InHire".planejamentos p
    SET porcentagem = (SELECT p_percentual FROM parametros)
    FROM alocacao_resolvida a
    WHERE p.id_alocacao = a.id
      AND p.mes = (SELECT p_mes FROM parametros)
      AND p.ano = (SELECT p_ano FROM parametros)
    RETURNING p.id
),
novo_planejamento AS (
    INSERT INTO "InHire".planejamentos (id_alocacao, mes, ano, porcentagem, status, deletado)
    SELECT a.id, (SELECT p_mes FROM parametros), (SELECT p_ano FROM parametros), (SELECT p_percentual FROM parametros), true, false
    FROM alocacao_resolvida a
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atualiza_planejamento)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT p_id_colab FROM parametros) AS id_colaborador,
    (SELECT id FROM id_final_demanda) AS id_demanda_alocada,
    (SELECT p_percentual FROM parametros) AS percentual_alocado;
